UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Information about a user in the system.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user from Firebase Auth.

customerNo.description: A unique customer number generated for the user.

role.description: The user's role in the system.

createdAt.description: When the user profile was created.

Loan.title: Loan Application
Loan.description: Details of a loan application or active loan.

id.description: The unique identifier for the loan.

userId.description: The UID of the user who applied for the loan.

amount.description: The principal amount of the loan.

status.description: The current status of the loan.

balance.description: The remaining balance to be paid.

totalAmount.description: The total amount to be paid including interest.

paidInstallments.description: The number of installments already paid.

nextPayment.description: The date of the next scheduled payment.

createdAt.description: When the loan application was created.

Transaction.title: Transaction Record
Transaction.description: A record of a financial transaction (loan disbursement or payment).

id.description: The unique identifier for the transaction.

userId.description: The UID of the user involved in the transaction.

loanId.description: The ID of the associated loan.

/users/{uid}.description: User profile documents indexed by their Firebase Auth UID.

/loans/{loanId}.description: Loan application and active loan documents.
